items:
LouLou and Studs Beachhouse Features
- Private pool with spa and splash pad. Pool can be heated for an additional fee for reservations October - April
- Complimentary Use of a 6-seater LSV (golf cart). Some restrictions apply and must sign a waiver to use the cart during your stay
- Enjoy 5 Taxi Bikes, perfect for exploring WaterColor and 30A
- All new and high-end EVERYTHING!
- Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 45 pounds or less, and non-shedding. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee/per pet is required prior to your arrival.
- Parking for 3 vehicles in the driveway
- Gourmet kitchen with high-end stainless-steel appliances
- Dining table with seating for 6, breakfast bar seating for 5, and outdoor dining for 8
- King Suite on the 1st floor is perfect for the grandparents
- The Carriage house apartment with king bed, kitchenette and full bath is great for anyone who wants a little extra private space
- 1st floor laundry room with HE washer and dryer
- Screened-in back porch overlooking pool deck with fireplace, bench swing, and outdoor dining
- Summer kitchen on pool deck with a natural gas grill and sink
- Enclosed outdoor shower perfect for cleaning up after a day at the beach
- 2nd floor game room with oversized bean bag chairs, classic arcade game, and large Smart TV
- Pack and Play available
- 3-minute bike ride or LSV (golf cart) drive to Camp WaterColor. Access to the water slides and lazy river included with your stay.
- 5-minute walk to Publix, The Perfect Pig, Driftwood Wine, and Pizza by the Sea
- Short bike ride or LSV (golf cart) drive to WaterColor beach club
- Access to the WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and all community pools included with your reservation for 14 guests ages 5 and older
- Community pools, including Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club, are heated during cooler months. Towel service available at Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club (subject to change by the neighborhood)
- Concierge services including grocery delivery, private chef, baby equipment rentals, and bike rentals available.
- At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee

5 Bedrooms, 6 full Baths and 1 Powder Room, Sleeps 14
- 1st Floor King Suite 1: walk-in closet, ensuite bath with walk-in shower and dual vanity sink
- 2nd Floor King Suite 2: walk-in closet, ensuite bath with soaking tub, dual vanity sink, and walk-in shower
- 2nd Floor King Suite 3: reach-in closet, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
- 2nd Floor Bunk Room with two Twin over Queen Bunks (sleeps up to 6): two reach-in closets, ensuite bath with two vanity sinks, walk-in shower with two shower heads
- Bonus: Twin daybed with trundle in game room (sleeps up to 2), barn door closure for privacy, hallway access to full bath with combination shower/tub
- Carriage House King Suite 4: kitchenette and full bath with walk-in shower

Private pool and spa, designer interiors, 6-seater LSV (golf cart), bikes, 3 min to Camp WaterColor. LouLou and Studs Beachhouse is PACKED with amenities you don't want to miss. It feels like you are staying in a private resort! Newly built, no detail was missed in this designer home. The well-designed floor plan has plenty of room for 14 guests to enjoy a luxury WaterColor vacation experience.

This home is simply a masterpiece. Crisp white interiors are accented with natural wood tones and relaxing blue details. The family chef will fall in love with the gourmet kitchen, while the kids and young at heart enjoy classic arcade games and large Smart TVs. The private pool can be heated during cooler months and the screened in porch has a stately fireplace, allowing you to enjoy this private oasis year-round. Everywhere you turn, you will be impressed by the attention to detail and glamorous design.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
